questions.solution:
Given series: 2, 6, 14, 30, 62, 126, 250

The pattern followed here is,

(2 + 1) × 2 = 6

(6 + 1) × 2 = 14

(14 + 1) × 2 = 30

(30 + 1) × 2 = 62

(62 + 1) × 2 = 126

(126 + 1) × 3 = 254 ≠ 250

So, instead of ‘250’, it should be ‘254’.

Hence, ‘250’ is the wrong term in the series.

questions.question: A + B means ‘A is the father of B’; A × B means ‘A is the brother of B’; A ÷ B means ‘A is the sister of B’. Which of the following expressions means ‘H is the paternal grandson of P’?
questions.questionHtml:
A + B means ‘A is the father of B’;

A × B means ‘A is the brother of B’;

A ÷ B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

Which of the following expressions means ‘H is the paternal grandson of P’?
questions.solution:
As per the given codes,

Symbol

+

×

÷

Meaning

Father

Brother

Sister

 

From the given information,

1) H + K + D × P ÷ M

H is father of K, K is father of D, D is brother of P, P is sister of M.

H is the paternal grandfather pf P.

2) P + K + D ÷ H × M

P is father of K, K is father of D, D is sister of H, H is brother of M

H is the paternal grandson of P.

3) P + K + D × H ÷ M

P is father of K, K is father of D, D is brother of H, H is sister of M

H is the paternal granddaughter of P.

4) D + H + K × M ÷ P

D is father of H, H is father of K, K is brother of M, M is sister of P

H is the father of P.

Hence, ‘P + K + D ÷ H × M’ is the correct answer.

questions.solution:
• 1921 is called the Year of the Great Divide in the demographic history of India. 
  • Prior to 1921, the population was quite unstable. It kept on increasing and decreasing without any pattern.
  • After 1921, the population showed a consistent increase.
  • The total increase in population was 5.9% between 1901 and 1911.

  • But after, 1921 it has shown an increased pattern only.

questions.question: What does GNP stand for?
questions.questionHtml: What does GNP stand for?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Gross National Product.

Key Points

  • GNP - Gross National Product. 
  • It is the total value of all the final products and services in a given period in terms of production by a country's residents.
  • It is calculated by taking the sum of personal consumption expenditures, domestic investment, expenditure by government, net exports, and any income earned by residents from overseas investments, and deducting the income earned within the domestic economy by foreign residents.
  • GDP is Gross Domestic Product. It is the national output produced in a country.
  • GNP = GDP + net property income from abroad

Speed of the first train = 60 km/hr

Speed of second train = 20 km/hr

Speed = Distance/Time

The given sentence is an interrogative statement in Direct speech. It needs to be changed in Indirect speech.

When we change the direct speech to indirect speech, the following changes take place:

  1. The Reporting Verb 'said to' changes to 'asked'.
  2. Inverted commas are omitted and the question mark is replaced with a full stop.
  3. 'If/whether' is added when it changes from direct to indirect mode.
  4. Modal auxiliary 'can' changes to 'could'.
  5. The personal pronoun 'I' changes to 'he'.
  6. Time phrase changes from 'now' to 'then'.

Following the rules of conversion, the indirect speech sentence will be: Rahul asked his mother if he could go out and play then.

questions.question: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence. Fortunately, the fire did not cause much damage.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Fortunately, the fire did not cause much damage.

options.html: Fortunately, not much damage is being caused by the fire.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Fortunately, not much damage was caused by the fire.

Key Points

The given sentence is in Active Voice. Its structure is: Adverb + subject + auxiliary verb + negative marker + main verb + object

It needs to be changed in Passive Voice. Its structure will be: Fortunately + negative marker + Object + helping verb + V3 + by + Subject.

Thus the correct sentence will be: Fortunately, not much damage was caused by the fire.

Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:

  • Identify the subject, the verb and the object: S+V+O
  • Change the object into subject
  • The active verb does not have an object. Therefore, the passive form should begin with you.
  • Change the verb into past participle of the verb
  • Change the subject into object

Other options are therefore incorrect as it does not follow the rules of conversion.

questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. These baits were temptations that people couldn't resist.

B. He evolved a theory that the world was a rat-trap.

C. Once, a peddler sat looking at his rat-traps.

D. Here, people lay baits for others.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.

When we connect the sentences it is important to establish a connection between them.

The sentences here talk about a man who is unhappy and dejected about the situation around him.

  • Sentence C introduces us to the subject 'a peddler' where he analyzes his rat-traps.
    Rat-traps is an unpleasant situation with no prospect of improvement.
  • B follows C. He evolved a theory that the world was a rat-trap.
  • DA follows as a pair. It states that people lay (baits) traps for others such that people could not resist.
  • Thus the correct order is CBDA.

Once, a peddler sat looking at his rat-traps. He evolved a theory that the world was a rat-trap. Here, people lay baits for others. These baits were temptations that people couldn't resist.
